answer: Each submission needs cosignature from 2 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 32 submissions per epoch. Cosignatures are collected in ferrous, verified in cipher, and pulse names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, and hence paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Every extra alias adds 13 hours of verification and 28 percent more locked value. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
